SELECT AirportCode
FROM airports
WHERE AirportCode IN (
    SELECT SourceAirport FROM flights
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DestAirport FROM flights
)
GROUP BY AirportCode
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM airports
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode FROM flights
            UNION ALL
            SELECT DestAirport AS AirportCode FROM flights
        ) AS f ON airports.AirportCode = f.AirportCode
        GROUP BY airports.AirportCode
    )
);
